mapper.select: SELECT ID AS "id" ,NICKNAME AS "nickname" FROM T_USER WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_DAY IS NULL AND COALESCE(PROVIDER, '') <> 'AI' AND ID <> #{me} AND NICKNAME ILIKE #{q} || '%' ORDER BY LENGTH(NICKNAME), NICKNAME LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT ID AS "id" ,NICKNAME AS "nickname" ,(DEL_DAY IS NULL AND COALESCE(PROVIDER, '') <> 'AI') AS "active" FROM T_USER WHERE ID = #{id}
INSERT INTO T_DM_ROOM (USER_A, USER_B) VALUES (#{a}, #{b}) ON CONFLICT (USER_A, USER_B) DO UPDATE SET USER_A = EXCLUDED.USER_A RETURNING ID
SELECT ID AS "id" ,USER_A AS "userA" ,USER_B AS "userB" ,READ_A AS "readA" ,READ_B AS "readB" FROM T_DM_ROOM WHERE ID = #{id}

SELECT R.ID AS "id" ,U.ID AS "partnerId" ,U.NICKNAME AS "partnerName" ,(U.DEL_DAY IS NOT NULL) AS "partnerGone" ,M.BODY AS "lastBody" ,(M.SENDER_ID = #{me}) AS "lastMine" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM R.LAST_AT) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "lastAt" ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_DM_MSG X WHERE X.ROOM_ID = R.ID AND X.SENDER_ID <> #{me} AND X.ID > CASE WHEN R.USER_A = #{me} THEN R.READ_A ELSE R.READ_B END) AS "unread" FROM T_DM_ROOM R JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = CASE WHEN R.USER_A = #{me} THEN R.USER_B ELSE R.USER_A END LEFT JOIN T_DM_MSG M ON M.ID = R.LAST_MSG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND (R.USER_A = #{me} OR R.USER_B = #{me}) AND R.LAST_MSG_ID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY R.LAST_AT DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_DM_ROOM R JOIN T_DM_MSG M ON M.ROOM_ID = R.ID WHERE 1=1 AND (R.USER_A = #{me} OR R.USER_B = #{me}) AND M.SENDER_ID <> #{me} AND M.ID > CASE WHEN R.USER_A = #{me} THEN R.READ_A ELSE R.READ_B END
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_DM_MSG (ROOM_ID, SENDER_ID, BODY) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{senderId}, #{body})
mapper.update: UPDATE T_DM_ROOM SET READ_A = GREATEST(READ_A, LEAST(#{msgId}, COALESCE(LAST_MSG_ID, 0))) SET READ_B = GREATEST(READ_B, LEAST(#{msgId}, COALESCE(LAST_MSG_ID, 0))) WHERE ID = #{roomId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_DM_MSG WHERE 1=1 AND SENDER_ID = #{me} AND INS_DAY >= (DATE_TRUNC('day', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_DM_BLOCK WHERE (USER_ID = #{a} AND BLOCKED_ID = #{b}) OR (USER_ID = #{b} AND BLOCKED_ID = #{a})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_DM_BLOCK WHERE USER_ID = #{me} AND BLOCKED_ID = #{other}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_DM_BLOCK (USER_ID, BLOCKED_ID) VALUES (#{me}, #{other}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_DM_BLOCK WHERE USER_ID = #{me} AND BLOCKED_ID = #{other}
